data.body:
[P2] Keep parent registration atomic during completion

With early completion in a FLAT map/parallel, a remaining branch can finish on its worker while the checkpoint worker closes the parent. `_render_operation_end` removes the parent's placeholder before `_start_span` registers its recording span. A branch reaching this guard during that gap is queued, but neither `_start_span` nor the completed-parent replacement drains that queue. Cleanup therefore drops the branch's terminal span and reports a missing parent despite its subsequent registration. Keep the placeholder registered until its atomic replacement, or drain deferred completions on every registration path. Add a synchronized regression covering this interleaving.
